rounds.text: Diligent Industries is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a price-to-book ratio of 0.82x compared to the sector benchmark of 1.64x [E2, E7]. This valuation gap is underscored by a discounted cash flow analysis suggesting an intrinsic value of Rs 5 per share, providing a substantial margin of safety of 53.3% [E42, E43]. Management confidence is high, evidenced by promoters increasing their stake to 63.49% [E40]. Furthermore, the company has demonstrated long-term operational efficiency, achieving compounded profit growth of 44% over the last decade and 40% over the last five years [E18, E19]. While the sector benefits from a tailwind [E60, E62], the company is actively improving its profitability, as seen in the operating margin expansion of 2 percentage points over the last three years [E30]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with a 0% dividend yield [E4], a negative trailing twelve-month sales growth of -16% [E17], and a low return on equity of 4% [E13, E29].
